edges.description: Unreabsorbed filtered sulfate appears in the urine.
Urinary sulfate loss lowers plasma sulfate.
Systemic sulfate depletion is measured as low plasma sulfate.
Sulfate deficiency is proposed by the authors to explain the otherwise unexplained perichondritis; the link is inferential.
Reproduces reduced proximal tubular sulfate reabsorption and hyposulfatemia.
